title: Northstar product analytics overview
audience: Product managers reviewing weekly activation and retention
scenario: Northstar is a read-only analytics workspace for the fictional Acme Cloud product.
task: Build a static desktop-first dashboard overview that remains usable on smaller screens and makes current filters and metric context explicit.

sections: Application shell with Overview, Funnels, Retention, Users, and Settings
Page header with Acme Cloud workspace, Last 30 days, and All platforms filters
Metric summaries: Active users 24,892; Activation 38.4%; Week-4 retention 21.7%; Expansion $84.2k
Activation trend with a text-accessible seven-point data series
Top acquisition sources table with Organic, Partner, Paid search, and Referral
Recent insight noting a 6.2% activation lift for invited teammates

requirements: Associate every metric with its label, value, and comparison context
Provide a text or table equivalent for any chart
Use a real table with headers for acquisition sources
Expose selected navigation and filter states in source semantics
Provide intentional horizontal overflow or stacking behavior for narrow screens
constraints: Do not fetch data or implement filter behavior
Do not invent metrics beyond those supplied
Do not rely on color alone for trends or selected states
Do not use charting libraries, canvas, or remote assets
evaluation_focus: Dense but understandable dashboard information architecture
Accessible alternatives for visual data displays
Explicit metric, filter, update-time, and state context
